html:
Hurricane Hugo struck Montserrat head on in September 1989 and damaged most of the buildings on the island. It also hit Guadeloupe, the US Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico and South Carolina.

On Montserrat the storm flattened homes, the hospital and the pier, and stripped the green hills. Rebuilding took years and much British aid.

The island had barely recovered when the Soufriere Hills volcano woke in 1995. The two disasters together emptied much of Montserrat and ended the studio era of Plymouth, where famous rock bands had recorded in the 1980s.
